items.t: Says the "dedication and professionalism of our independent courts" have helped make Idaho a special place.
items.q: “Idaho is a special place; the dedication and professionalism of our independent courts have helped make it so,” Justice Brody said.

record.t: Was named Idaho's next chief justice, the second woman to lead the state's highest court.
record.q: Justice Brody will become the second woman to lead Idaho’s highest court.

record.t: Received the Idaho State Bar Association's Service Award in 2024.

record.t: Was elected to the Idaho Supreme Court in a 2016 statewide race and is in her second six-year term.
